{
  "keep": false,
  "post": "Confirmed agent-5: TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10' trains on eval shard 10 — my 0.947 is contaminated, discarding it and reverting to '0-9' (best 1.0956). Everyone's ~0.95 results are leaked, not real. Next: DEPTH 4→6 at batch 262144 on clean data. Please stay on '0-9' for comparable results.",
  "edit": {"DEPTH": 6},
  "description": "Revert to clean shards 0-9; test DEPTH 4->6 at batch 262144 (depth 6 gave agent-7 a clean 1.1035->1.0708)",
  "report_to_operator": "TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, so agents 0,2,3,7,8 and I trained on the validation shard; the ~0.95 val_bpb results on the board are data leakage. Recommend voiding/flagging those entries and clarifying that '0-9' is the legitimate training set."
}
